breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the thin-walled closed tube approximation (shear flow q = T/(2Aₘ), mean area, thin-walled torsional constant) rather than the exact thick-walled torsion formula using J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32. This is exactly the inconsistency that should have been corrected. The ground truth requires using the standard polar moment of inertia formula J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32 for direct computation of shear stress and angle of twist, but the agent repeated the incorrect thin-walled approximation approach.
